C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to create like denominators before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after like denominators are already available.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number fraction part unless a new common denominator is also found.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper mixed-number fraction part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a fraction-only quantity is treated as 0 plus a fraction to align whole and fractional parts.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag simple separation of already-standard mixed numbers unless a missing part is explicitly supplied or an improper mixed number is normalized.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag final combine-only steps with no subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator-over-denominator and add it to the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole-number part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed 1 is rewritten as n/n using the current denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when subtraction is recomputed after borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fractional part is already nonnegative.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or simplify a zero-fraction result to a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a combined expression like 1 + 0/8 is simplified to an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce an already simplified result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional parts unless simplification is also performed.
Do not tag denominator matching or borrowing.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when the final answer is stated after combining previously computed parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure subtraction steps that have not yet formed the final expression.
Do not tag simplification alone unless parts are also being recombined.
Do not tag operand rewriting at the start of the problem.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for two fractions.
Tag when a step rewrites one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as for pure fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that add one whole as n/n after denominators are already aligned.
Do not tag simplification to lowest terms after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-plus-fraction form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form with 0 fractional part, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when this rewriting is done to make whole and fractional parts subtractable.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary decomposition of an already standard mixed number unless a rewrite is explicitly performed.
Do not tag finding a common denominator for unlike fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator, including cases like (6−4)/7.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after setup is complete.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination unless actual subtraction occurs in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative fractional part during subtraction of mixed numbers or whole-minus-fraction expressions.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator, such as 1 = 5/5 or 12/12.
Tag when the whole part is reduced by 1 and the fractional part is increased before re-subtracting.
Tag for regrouping in same-denominator or unlike-denominator mixed-number contexts once denominators are aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag if no regrouping is needed because the fractional part is already nonnegative.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as 0/d unless it is part of an explicit borrow after subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction part into an integer/whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 = 1/5 or 9/12 = 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed-number result is simplified because the fractional part becomes 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that already produce a lowest-terms answer without an explicit simplification action.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper fractional part inside an input mixed number.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final value.
Tag when a result like 0 13/24 is expressed as 13/24.
Tag when a whole plus zero-fraction result is stated as an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction or borrowing steps themselves.
Do not tag simplification unless the step's main action is recombining the parts into final form.
Do not tag setup steps such as finding common denominators or rewriting inputs.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as 0 over a denominator unless it is part of matching unlike denominators.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number fractional part; that belongs to a different skill.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to standard form or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 is normalized to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a fraction-only or mixed/whole expression is decomposed into whole and fractional parts to align the operands.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding a common denominator between two nonmatching fractions; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has produced a negative fractional part; that is S04.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts; that is S06.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of like fractions and/or subtract whole-number parts once the operands are in aligned form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like fractions are subtracted directly, such as 6/8 − 3/8 or (6−4)/7.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution step subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after alignment or normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates common denominators; that is S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional result; that is S04.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction or zero fraction; that is S05.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator, such as 1 = 5/5 or 12/12.
Tag when subtraction first yields a negative fractional part and then is corrected by regrouping.
Tag in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problems requiring borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fractional part is already large enough.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction; that is S02.
Do not tag simplification after borrowing has produced the final fraction; that is S05.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms or simplify a zero fraction to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 = 1/5 or 9/12 = 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when simplification is explicitly shown before or during the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself if no reduction is performed.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly carried out.
Do not tag answers already in lowest terms when no simplification step is shown.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the result in an acceptable final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted, such as 0 13/24 becoming 13/24.
Tag when the final result is stated as an integer after combining whole and zero-fraction parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly forms the final mixed number or integer.
Do not tag mere classification statements like Type C or Type E.
